evidence.note: Dozens of ~1 px light-grey spoke lines run from small agent-run dots to the package mirror; thin, low-contrast strokes that compression would smear or erase.
At the small size the spokes become hairlines and the agent-run dots shrink to a few pixels with thin outlines.
The 'PUBLIC INTERNET' zone label and globe icon are very pale grey on near-white, faint small text.
'PUBLIC INTERNET' label is roughly 12 px pale grey; the bell-off icon is thin-stroked and small.
Title, timeline entries and the Evaluation Board callout are large, high-contrast and use soft-shadowed cards; no texture or grain anywhere.

rationale: Type for title, timeline and callouts is generous and the background is flat colour with no grain. But the central diagram depends on many 1 px light-grey spoke lines and tiny outlined dots, and the 'PUBLIC INTERNET' label is small faint grey text, which matches the fail descriptor of hairlines and small faint text that compression would erase. This is worst at the 1288x598 size.
